# Cobalt Freight — Managed processing standard

Version 1.0. Effective 1 September 2026.

This standard defines the three supplier obligations reviewed for the named service. Descriptions of internal filing and contacts do not create additional supplier duties. Evidence is assessed as of 17 September 2026; an exception applies only where its conditions are documented.

## 1. Encrypted backups

All backups containing Cobalt personal data must be encrypted at rest, including temporary recovery copies.

## 2. Approval for extraction

Every bulk export of Cobalt data must receive customer approval before it starts. Scheduled maintenance does not create an exception.

## 3. Export audit trail

Every bulk export of Cobalt data must produce an audit record identifying the customer approver, start time and exported dataset, retained for at least 120 calendar days.
